_doc: Tenant apps that run on Ultrastable's Cloudflare account, read by dashboard/worker.js (OWNER-DASH-2). One row per tenant: where it runs, its database, its status and what is next. A row with a url is probed hourly (check tenant:<id>); a row without one is shown as pending. Change a status by PR: the dashboard serves what is here, so a stale row is a defect the tenant's own probe replaces.
